astroPortfolio.shortDescription: Interactive engineering dashboard for visualizing production and process data.
astroPortfolio.challenge: Engineers lacked a clear overview of production metrics and machine performance.
astroPortfolio.approach: Built a dashboard using Python and Dash to visualize key KPIs and process data in real time.
astroPortfolio.result: Improved transparency of production data and supported faster engineering decisions.

coreprotectWebUI.shortDescription: Machine state detection system using vibration sensors and a Raspberry Pi.
coreprotectWebUI.challenge: No reliable way to automatically determine whether a machine was actively running.
coreprotectWebUI.approach: Used an accelerometer and Python-based data logging to detect vibration patterns and determine machine state.
coreprotectWebUI.result: Enabled automated machine monitoring and created a foundation for production analytics.

templateCollection.shortDescription: Development and optimization of CNC grinding programs for precision cutting tools.
templateCollection.challenge: Producing complex cutting tool geometries with high accuracy and repeatability.
templateCollection.approach: Created and refined CNC grinding programs and technical documentation to ensure stable and repeatable production.
templateCollection.result: Improved process reliability and ensured consistent tool quality in production.
